API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIProvisioningGet Api Keys
Get Api Keys
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/apiKeys

Lists available API keys.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
includePartnerKey
boolean

Include or exclude partner keys from the list.

Responses
​
200
400
401
403

OK

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

ID of the API key. This is used to regenerate the API key.

keyValue
string

API key value (12 alphanumeric characters in length).

permissions
string[]

List of functional areas to which this API key applies. This attribute is subject to change.

Possible values: [USER_ACCESS, SECURE, MANAGE, COMPLY, SSL_POLICY, ADVANCED_SETTINGS, TRAFFIC_FORWARDING, AUTHENTICATION_CONFIGURATION, FIREWALL_DNS, NSS_CONFIGURATION, VZEN_CONFIGURATION, LOCATIONS, HOSTED_PAC_FILES, EZ_AGENT_CONFIGURATIONS, SECURE_AGENT_NOTIFICATIONS, VPN_CREDENTIALS, PROXY_GATEWAY, STATIC_IPS, GRE_TUNNELS, SUBCLOUDS, AUTHENTICATION_SETTINGS, IDENTITY_PROXY_SETTINGS, USER_MANAGEMENT, APIKEY_MANAGEMENT, PARTNER_INTEGRATION, POLICY_RESOURCE_MANAGEMENT, CUSTOM_URL_CAT, OVERRIDE_EXISTING_CAT, TENANT_PROFILE_MANAGEMENT, CLIENT_CONNECTOR_PORTAL, CUSTOMER_ACCT_INFO, CUSTOMER_SUBSCRIPTION, CUSTOMER_ORG_SETTINGS, REMOTE_ASSISTANCE_MANAGEMENT, ZDX_CONFIGURATION, ZDX_EXECUTIVE_INSIGHTS, ZDX_ADMIN_MANAGEMENT, ZDX_USER_DEVICE_NAME_ACCESS, ZDX_DASHBOARD, ZDX_ALERTS, ZDX_LTSESSION, ZDX_WEBHOOKS, ZDX_ONBOARDING, ZDX_INTERNAL, ZDX_UCAAS, ZDX_UCAAS_NAME_ACCESS, ZDX_MA_ACCESS, ZDX_CLIENT_APPS, ZDX_ADMIN_SETTINGS, ZDX_DEVICE_INVENTORY, ZDX_YENGINE_SVC, ZDX_DASHBOARD_PERF, ZDX_DASHBOARD_APP_OVERVIEW, ZDX_DASHBOARD_APP_DASHBOARD, ZDX_DASHBOARD_USER_OVERVIEW, ZDX_DASHBOARD_USER_DASHBOARD, ZDX_USER_SEARCH_ACCESS, ZDX_USER_NAME_ACCESS, ZDX_LOCATION_ACCESS, ZDX_DEVICE_NAME_ACCESS, ZDX_IP_ADDRESS_ACCESS, ZDX_UCAAS_CONFIGURATION, ZDX_UCAAS_MEETING, ZDX_UCAAS_APPLICATION, ZDX_TIME_DURATION, ZDX_EPT, ZDX_YENGINE_ANALYSIS, ZDX_PCAP_CAPTURE, EDGE_CONNECTOR_DASHBOARD, EDGE_CONNECTOR_CLOUD_PROVISIONING, EDGE_CONNECTOR_ADMIN_MANAGEMENT, EDGE_CONNECTOR_LOCATION_MANAGEMENT, EDGE_CONNECTOR_FORWARDING, EDGE_CONNECTOR_NSS_CONFIGURATION, EDGE_CONNECTOR_TEMPLATE, CSPM_CONFIGURATION, DEVICE_NAME_ACCESS, ZSCALER_DECEPTION_PORTAL]

enabled
boolean

Indicates whether API key is enabled.

lastModifiedTime
int32

Last time API key was modified.

lastModifiedBy
object
partner
object
partnerUrl
string

Not applicable to Cloud & Branch Connector.

]
